name: kalanchoe daigremontiana leaf + lachesis muta venom + silver + strychnos ignatii seed
purpose: Use: Temporary relief of hot flashes.
otcwarn: Warnings: Claims based on traditional homeopathic practice, not accepted medical evidence. Not FDA evaluated. Do not use if allergic to any ingredient. Consult a doctor before use for serious conditions or if conditions worsen or persist. If pregnant or nursing, consult a doctor before use.
